title.narrative: Agosl MicroMill: cost & product optimisation to eradicate diesel mills

description.narrative: Within the PUE space, solar milling stands out as a crucial challenge to address. Currently in Africa, about 500 million people rely on outdated and polluting diesel mills, creating numerous issues, including women wasting time, food prices tied to fuel costs, contaminated food, male-dominated industry, and CO2 emissions.Conversely, solar milling presents a complicated PUE technology to bring to market because margins are slim in staple food processing, and current technology is inefficient requiring large and expensive solar systems. The solution requires innovation across multiple engineering disciplines and business models.Over four years, Agsol has worked to create the most efficient, smart, and affordable milling machine ever developed – the MicroMill – made possible with support from EforA. The MicroMill comprises a custom brushless DC motor, an industry-first automatic feed control system, smart power electronics, and other unique components brought together in a configuration that makes it over two times more efficient than any other small electric mill in its class. The MicroMill is not just an improvement on current technology, it is a complete step change.In the latest collaboration with EforA, we developed the MicroMill v2, manufactured 100 units and deployed 85 to market. Results have been overwhelmingly positive and have encouraged Agsol to commercialise the MicroMill v2. Presently, we are establishing a manufacturing facility in China and moving on a 500 unit production run. By 2027 our goal is to sell 50,000 an, positively impacting over 10 million lives.The project has two primary R&D activities that will directly support our near term ambitions of preparing for mass manufacturing. These are related to cost reduction and feature enhancementCost reduction is Agsol’s primary goal for the MicroMill in the period ahead. For our current version 2 (v2) series that we are going to market with, the opportunity for cost reduction primarily relates to identifying, procuring and testing new peripheral components, specifically the AC-DC power adapter and the battery. Other cost reduction opportunities also exist for the MicroMill, including custom milling chamber, design optimisation and board optimisation, however, these are outside the scope of this project.Feature enhancements will include advanced on-board analytics, on-board data logging, firmware development for paygo and increased interoperability, specifically with e-motorbikes.
